arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,
translations.en.pickthall: When the event befalleth -
translations.en.yusufali: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila terjadi hari kiamat,

translations.en.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
translations.en.pickthall: There is no denying that it will befall -
translations.en.yusufali: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
translations.id.indonesian: tidak seorangpun dapat berdusta tentang kejadiannya.

translations.en.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
translations.en.pickthall: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
translations.en.yusufali: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
translations.id.indonesian: (Kejadian itu) merendahkan (satu golongan) dan meninggikan (golongan yang lain),

translations.en.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
translations.en.pickthall: When the earth is shaken with a shock
translations.en.yusufali: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
translations.id.indonesian: apabila bumi digoncangkan sedahsyat-dahsyatnya,

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
translations.en.pickthall: And the hills are ground to powder
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
translations.id.indonesian: dan gunung-gunung dihancur luluhkan seluluh-luluhnya,

translations.en.sahih: And become dust dispersing.
translations.en.pickthall: So that they become a scattered dust,
translations.en.yusufali: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
translations.id.indonesian: maka jadilah ia debu yang beterbangan,

translations.en.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:
translations.en.pickthall: And ye will be three kinds:
translations.en.yusufali: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu menjadi tiga golongan.

transliteration: Fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah

translations.en.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
translations.en.pickthall: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
translations.en.yusufali: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
translations.id.indonesian: Yaitu golongan kanan. Alangkah mulianya golongan kanan itu.

transliteration: Wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
translations.en.pickthall: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
translations.en.yusufali: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan golongan kiri. Alangkah sengsaranya golongan kiri itu.

translations.en.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
translations.en.pickthall: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
translations.en.yusufali: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang beriman paling dahulu,

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
translations.en.pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh
translations.en.yusufali: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itulah yang didekatkan kepada Allah.

translations.en.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
translations.en.pickthall: In gardens of delight;
translations.en.yusufali: In Gardens of Bliss:
translations.id.indonesian: Berada dalam jannah kenikmatan.

translations.en.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples
translations.en.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
translations.en.yusufali: A number of people from those of old,
translations.id.indonesian: Segolongan besar dari orang-orang yang terdahulu,

translations.en.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,
translations.en.pickthall: And a few of those of later time.
translations.en.yusufali: And a few from those of later times.
translations.id.indonesian: dan segolongan kecil dari orang-orang yang kemudian

translations.en.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],
translations.en.pickthall: On lined couches,
translations.en.yusufali: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berada di atas dipan yang bertahta emas dan permata,

translations.en.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.
translations.en.pickthall: Reclining therein face to face.
translations.en.yusufali: Reclining on them, facing each other.
translations.id.indonesian: seraya bertelekan di atasnya berhadap-hadapan.

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
translations.en.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths
translations.en.yusufali: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka dikelilingi oleh anak-anak muda yang tetap muda,

transliteration: Bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een

translations.en.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
translations.en.pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
translations.en.yusufali: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
translations.id.indonesian: dengan membawa gelas, cerek dan minuman yang diambil dari air yang mengalir,

translations.en.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
translations.en.pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
translations.en.yusufali: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tidak pening karenanya dan tidak pula mabuk,

translations.en.sahih: And fruit of what they select
translations.en.pickthall: And fruit that they prefer
translations.en.yusufali: And with fruits, any that they may select:
translations.id.indonesian: dan buah-buahan dari apa yang mereka pilih,

translations.en.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
translations.en.pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
translations.en.yusufali: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
translations.id.indonesian: dan daging burung dari apa yang mereka inginkan.

translations.en.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
translations.en.pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
translations.en.yusufali: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ada bidadari-bidadari bermata jeli,

translations.en.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
translations.en.pickthall: Like unto hidden pearls,
translations.en.yusufali: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
translations.id.indonesian: laksana mutiara yang tersimpan baik.

translations.en.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.
translations.en.pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.
translations.en.yusufali: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
translations.id.indonesian: Sebagai balasan bagi apa yang telah mereka kerjakan.

arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa

translations.en.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
translations.en.pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
translations.en.yusufali: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak mendengar di dalamnya perkataan yang sia-sia dan tidak pula perkataan yang menimbulkan dosa,

translations.en.sahih: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
translations.en.pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
translations.en.yusufali: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
translations.id.indonesian: akan tetapi mereka mendengar ucapan salam.

transliteration: Wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul Yameen

translations.en.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
translations.en.pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
translations.en.yusufali: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan golongan kanan, alangkah bahagianya golongan kanan itu.

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
translations.en.pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees
translations.en.yusufali: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
translations.id.indonesian: Berada di antara pohon bidara yang tak berduri,

translations.en.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
translations.en.pickthall: And clustered plantains,
translations.en.yusufali: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan pohon pisang yang bersusun-susun (buahnya),

translations.en.sahih: And shade extended
translations.en.pickthall: And spreading shade,
translations.en.yusufali: In shade long-extended,
translations.id.indonesian: dan naungan yang terbentang luas,

translations.en.sahih: And water poured out
translations.en.pickthall: And water gushing,
translations.en.yusufali: By water flowing constantly,
translations.id.indonesian: dan air yang tercurah,

translations.en.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
translations.en.pickthall: And fruit in plenty
translations.en.yusufali: And fruit in abundance.
translations.id.indonesian: dan buah-buahan yang banyak,

translations.en.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
translations.en.pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
translations.en.yusufali: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
translations.id.indonesian: yang tidak berhenti (berbuah) dan tidak terlarang mengambilnya.

translations.en.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.
translations.en.pickthall: And raised couches;
translations.en.yusufali: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
translations.id.indonesian: dan kasur-kasur yang tebal lagi empuk.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
translations.en.yusufali: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan mereka (bidadari-bidadari) dengan langsung

translations.en.sahih: And made them virgins,
translations.en.pickthall: And made them virgins,
translations.en.yusufali: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan mereka gadis-gadis perawan.

translations.en.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
translations.en.pickthall: Lovers, friends,
translations.en.yusufali: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
translations.id.indonesian: penuh cinta lagi sebaya umurnya.

translations.en.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]
translations.en.pickthall: For those on the right hand;
translations.en.yusufali: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
translations.id.indonesian: (Kami ciptakan mereka) untuk golongan kanan,

translations.en.sahih: A company of the former peoples
translations.en.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
translations.en.yusufali: A (goodly) number from those of old,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) segolongan besar dari orang-orang yang terdahulu.

translations.en.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.
translations.en.yusufali: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
translations.id.indonesian: dan segolongan besar pula dari orang-orang yang kemudian.

transliteration: Wa as haabush shimaali maaa as haabush shimaal

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
translations.en.pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
translations.en.yusufali: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan golongan kiri, siapakah golongan kiri itu?

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
translations.en.pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water
translations.en.yusufali: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
translations.id.indonesian: Dalam (siksaan) angin yang amat panas, dan air panas yang mendidih,

translations.en.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,
translations.en.pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,
translations.en.yusufali: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
translations.id.indonesian: dan dalam naungan asap yang hitam.

translations.en.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.
translations.en.pickthall: Neither cool nor refreshing.
translations.en.yusufali: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak sejuk dan tidak menyenangkan.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
translations.en.yusufali: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka sebelum itu hidup bermewahan.

translations.en.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,
translations.en.pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.
translations.en.yusufali: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka terus-menerus mengerjakan dosa besar.

arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
transliteration: Wa kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa izaaman'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

translations.en.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
translations.en.pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
translations.en.yusufali: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka selalu mengatakan: "Apakah bila kami mati dan menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kami akan benar-benar dibangkitkan kembali?

translations.en.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
translations.en.pickthall: And also our forefathers?
translations.en.yusufali: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
translations.id.indonesian: apakah bapak-bapak kami yang terdahulu (juga)?"

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
translations.en.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang terdahulu dan orang-orang yang terkemudian,

translations.en.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
translations.en.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
translations.en.yusufali: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
translations.id.indonesian: benar-benar akan dikumpulkan di waktu tertentu pada hari yang dikenal.

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
translations.en.yusufali: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian sesungguhnya kamu hai orang-orang yang sesat lagi mendustakan,

transliteration: La aakiloona min shaja rim min zaqqoom

translations.en.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
translations.en.pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
translations.en.yusufali: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
translations.id.indonesian: benar-benar akan memakan pohon zaqqum,

translations.en.sahih: And filling with it your bellies
translations.en.pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;
translations.en.yusufali: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
translations.id.indonesian: dan akan memenuhi perutmu dengannya.

translations.en.sahih: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
translations.en.pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
translations.en.yusufali: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesudah itu kamu akan meminum air yang sangat panas.

translations.en.sahih: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
translations.en.pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
translations.en.yusufali: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kamu minum seperti unta yang sangat haus minum.

translations.en.sahih: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
translations.en.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah hidangan untuk mereka pada hari Pembalasan".

translations.en.sahih: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
translations.en.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
translations.en.yusufali: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
translations.id.indonesian: Kami telah menciptakan kamu, maka mengapa kamu tidak membenarkan?

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen that which you emit?
translations.en.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
translations.en.yusufali: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka terangkanlah kepadaku tentang nutfah yang kamu pancarkan.

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
translations.en.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
translations.en.yusufali: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
translations.id.indonesian: Kamukah yang menciptakannya, atau Kamikah yang menciptakannya?

arabic: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
transliteration: Nahnu qaddarnaa baina kumul mawta wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen

translations.en.sahih: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
translations.en.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
translations.en.yusufali: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
translations.id.indonesian: Kami telah menentukan kematian di antara kamu dan Kami sekali-sekali tidak akan dapat dikalahkan,

arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: 'Alaaa an nubaddila amsaalakum wa nunshi'akum fee maa laa ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
translations.en.yusufali: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
translations.id.indonesian: untuk menggantikan kamu dengan orang-orang yang seperti kamu (dalam dunia) dan menciptakan kamu kelak (di akhirat) dalam keadaan yang tidak kamu ketahui.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad 'alimtumun nash atal oolaa falaw laa tazakkaroon

translations.en.sahih: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
translations.en.yusufali: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Sesungguhnya kamu telah mengetahui penciptaan yang pertama, maka mengapakah kamu tidak mengambil pelajaran (untuk penciptaan yang kedua)?

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
translations.en.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
translations.en.yusufali: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka terangkanlah kepadaku tentang yang kamu tanam.

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
translations.en.pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
translations.en.yusufali: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
translations.id.indonesian: Kamukah yang menumbuhkannya atau Kamikah yang menumbuhkannya?

arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
transliteration: Law nashaaa'u laja'al naahu hutaaman fazaltum tafakkahoon

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
translations.en.pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
translations.en.yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
translations.id.indonesian: Kalau Kami kehendaki, benar-benar Kami jadikan dia hancur dan kering, maka jadilah kamu heran dan tercengang.

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!
translations.en.yusufali: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
translations.id.indonesian: (Sambil berkata): "Sesungguhnya kami benar-benar menderita kerugian",

translations.en.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but we are deprived!
translations.en.yusufali: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
translations.id.indonesian: bahkan kami menjadi orang-orang yang tidak mendapat hasil apa-apa.

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen the water that you drink?
translations.en.pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
translations.en.yusufali: See ye the water which ye drink?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka terangkanlah kepadaku tentang air yang kamu minum.

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
transliteration: 'A-antum anzaltumoohu minal muzni am nahnul munziloon

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
translations.en.pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
translations.en.yusufali: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
translations.id.indonesian: Kamukah yang menurunkannya atau Kamikah yang menurunkannya?

arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
transliteration: Law nashaaa'u ja'alnaahu ujaajan falaw laa tashkuroon

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
translations.en.pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
translations.en.yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
translations.id.indonesian: Kalau Kami kehendaki, niscaya Kami jadikan dia asin, maka mengapakah kamu tidak bersyukur?

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
translations.en.pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
translations.en.yusufali: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka terangkanlah kepadaku tentang api yang kamu nyalakan (dengan menggosok-gosokkan kayu).

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
translations.en.pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
translations.en.yusufali: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
translations.id.indonesian: Kamukah yang menjadikan kayu itu atau Kamikah yang menjadikannya?

transliteration: Nahnu ja'alnaahaa tazkira tanw wa mataa'al lilmuqween

translations.en.sahih: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
translations.en.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
translations.en.yusufali: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami jadikan api itu untuk peringatan dan bahan yang berguna bagi musafir di padang pasir.

translations.en.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.en.yusufali: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bertasbihlah dengan (menyebut) nama Rabbmu Yang Maha Besar.

translations.en.sahih: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
translations.en.yusufali: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Aku bersumpah dengan masa turunnya bagian-bagian Al-Quran.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
translations.en.yusufali: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya sumpah itu adalah sumpah yang besar kalau kamu mengetahui.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
translations.en.pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
translations.en.yusufali: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Al-Quran ini adalah bacaan yang sangat mulia,

translations.en.sahih: In a Register well-protected;
translations.en.pickthall: In a Book kept hidden
translations.en.yusufali: In Book well-guarded,
translations.id.indonesian: pada kitab yang terpelihara (Lauhul Mahfuzh),

translations.en.sahih: None touch it except the purified.
translations.en.pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,
translations.en.yusufali: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
translations.id.indonesian: tidak menyentuhnya kecuali orang-orang yang disucikan.

translations.en.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Diturunkan dari Rabbil 'alamiin.

translations.en.sahih: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
translations.en.pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
translations.en.yusufali: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu menganggap remeh saja Al-Quran ini?

translations.en.sahih: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
translations.en.pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
translations.en.yusufali: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
translations.id.indonesian: kamu mengganti rezeki (yang Allah berikan) dengan mendustakan Allah.

translations.en.sahih: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
translations.en.pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
translations.en.yusufali: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mengapa ketika nyawa sampai di kerongkongan,

translations.en.sahih: And you are at that time looking on -
translations.en.pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking
translations.en.yusufali: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
translations.id.indonesian: padahal kamu ketika itu melihat,

arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum wa laakil laa tubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
translations.en.pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
translations.en.yusufali: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami lebih dekat kepadanya dari pada kamu. Tetapi kamu tidak melihat,

transliteration: Falaw laaa in kuntum ghira madeeneen

translations.en.sahih: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
translations.en.pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
translations.en.yusufali: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
translations.id.indonesian: maka mengapa jika kamu tidak dikuasai (oleh Allah)?

translations.en.sahih: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
translations.en.pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
translations.en.yusufali: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
translations.id.indonesian: Kamu tidak mengembalikan nyawa itu (kepada tempatnya) jika kamu adalah orang-orang yang benar?

transliteration: Fa ammaaa in kaana minal muqarrabeen

translations.en.sahih: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
translations.en.pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
translations.en.yusufali: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
translations.id.indonesian: adapun jika dia (orang yang mati) termasuk orang-orang yang didekatkan (kepada Allah),

transliteration: Farawhunw wa raihaa nunw wa jannatu na'eem

translations.en.sahih: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
translations.en.yusufali: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
translations.id.indonesian: maka dia memperoleh ketenteraman dan rezeki serta jannah kenikmatan.

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
transliteration: Wa ammaaa in kaana min as haabil yameen

translations.en.sahih: And if he was of the companions of the right,
translations.en.pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,
translations.en.yusufali: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun jika dia termasuk golongan kanan,

transliteration: Fasalaamul laka min as haabil yameen

translations.en.sahih: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
translations.en.pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
translations.en.yusufali: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
translations.id.indonesian: maka keselamatanlah bagimu karena kamu dari golongan kanan.

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
transliteration: Wa ammaaa in kaana minal mukazzibeenad daaalleen

translations.en.sahih: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
translations.en.pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
translations.en.yusufali: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun jika dia termasuk golongan yang mendustakan lagi sesat,

translations.en.sahih: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
translations.en.pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water
translations.en.yusufali: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
translations.id.indonesian: maka dia mendapat hidangan air yang mendidih,

translations.en.sahih: And burning in Hellfire
translations.en.pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.
translations.en.yusufali: And burning in Hell-Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: dan dibakar di dalam jahannam.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this is certain truth.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (yang disebutkan ini) adalah suatu keyakinan yang benar.

translations.en.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.en.yusufali: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bertasbihlah dengan (menyebut) nama Rabbmu yang Maha Besar.
